text: Знаете, после хохлячьего визга "А нас-то за шо?" из-за череды непрерывных ударов по инфраструктуре Украины мне подумалось, что не рискнут они баллистикой бить по Москве, ибо побоятся, ибо разум ещё где-то на задворках у них не потух. Ведь в военном отношении такой удар принесет полный ноль, а вот в медийке они получат вистов, если что-то пролетит. Но видя теперь как долбят абсолютно мирный курорт Сочи — столицу зимних олимпийских игр в 2014-м, я понял, что зря засомневался, теша себя мыслью о наличии зачатков здравомыслия у потомков "древней свидомой цивилизации". Это тотальная всепожирающая ненависть и неадекват. Эти пойдут на всё. Этническая ОПГ, захватившая власть в Киеве, не остановится ни перед чем. Поэтому какой вывод нам? Бить, бить и бить. Наносить массированные удары первыми, не ждать новых капель в и без того переполненную чашу народного гнева. Мы пошли с мечом их вразумлять? Ну так вразумим тогда по полной, без остановок на тирамису и айфоны подонкам, которые вдруг полюбили сдаваться русским в плен на бис. Пора бить по плотинам, мостам, всей этой мерзкой скотине, захватывающей храмы и ежеминутно изрыгающей русофобию. Бить первыми, а не в ответ за Сочи, за Донецк и Луганс

Lumpy skin disease is a viral infection mainly spread by biting insects that affects cattle. It causes fever and painful skin lumps, weakens animals and reduces milk output. The disease does not infect humans. The disease, which is widespread in North Africa, was detected in several European countries last year. text: Drones Hit Russia's Gas Hinterland in Northern Siberia for the First Time By Reuters Sep. 9, 2026 The Zapolyarnoye gas field. Artyukhov did not identify the facility involved. "Most importantly, there were no fatalities or injuries. The extent and nature of the damage are being determined," he said on the Telegram messaging app. State-run energy company Gazprom did not reply to a request for comment about the attack on the region, some 3,000 kilometers (1,800 miles) from the Ukrainian border. Novy Urengoy is Russia's unofficial gas capital, located in the Yamal-Nenets autonomous district in northwestern Siberia. Gazprom used to export gas from Yamal as far as western Europe until the ties broke down following the start of Russia's war in Ukraine in 2022. title: Russians Aboard Ship Seized by Norway Have Returned Home, Foreign Ministry Says
text: Russians Aboard Ship Seized by Norway Have Returned Home, Foreign Ministry Says Sep. 9, 2026 The Professor Molchanov. Alexander Ermolin / Handout via REUTERS A group of Russians who were on board a ship seized by Norway last week have returned home , Russia’s Foreign Ministry said Wednesday, as it accused authorities in Oslo of trying to push Russia out of the Norwegian Arctic archipelago of Svalbard. The 69 Russian passengers and crew members were stuck for several days after a Norwegian court on Wednesday ordered the seizure of the Professor Molchanov, which operates as a cruise ship, at the request of the Ukrainian energy company Naftogaz. Norwegian authorities said Tuesday that they had helped the group of Russians return home. Russia’s Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova credited Oslo’s “logistical support” in their return, as well as the help of Russian diplomats. “As far as we know, practically everyone has already returned home,” Zakharova said. But the legal and diplomatic standoff over the seized vessel is “far from being resolved,” she warned, adding that Russia plans to appeal the arrest of the Professor Molchanov. news Norway Seizes Russian Ship to Enforce $4.

text: Kabardino-Balkaria Avalanche Deathtoll Climbs to 13 as Rescue Efforts Continue Sep. 9, 2026 Emergency personnel board a helicopter. Russian Emergencies Ministry At least 13 people are now confirmed to have died after an avalanche struck a group of climbers in the North Caucasus republic of Kabardino-Balkaria, Russian emergency services said Wednesday. The avalanche swept down Mount Mizhirgi, one of the highest peaks in the North Caucasus, at around 5 p.m. local time on Sunday, hitting a group of 33 climbers. Ten climbers had made their own way down the mountain by Monday morning. Russia’s Emergency Situations Ministry said 12 bodies had been lowered to the Bezengi base camp on Tuesday evening, with the fate of five climbers still unknown. By Wednesday morning, the ministry said rescuers found the body of the 13th climber. Russia’s National Guard said some of its servicemen were among the dead. Підкреслю, що організація відіграє одну з ключових ролей в енергетичній підтримці не лише Київщини, але й всієї України. Наразі це вкрай актуально. Також подякував пану Де Кроо за його особисті зусилля з підтримки України на посаді премʼєр-міністра Бельгії. Від всіх нас — ми памʼятаємо цей внесок! В короткі перерви між тривогами ми відвідали молодь в одній з громад області. Молодіжний простір тут — це результат спільних зусиль, яких сьогодні потребує Київщина. Try again Cover image: ENTRE NOUS © FRANCE 24 06:02 Issued on: 09/09/2026 - 15:05 Modified: 09/09/2026 - 15:14 06:02 min Share From the show Reading time 1 min In today’s edition, FRANCE 24’s Delano D'Souza speaks with the man at the heart of France's food supply chain. Stéphane Layani is the head of the Rungis wholesale food market – the largest of its kind in Europe – and chairman of the World Union of Wholesale Markets. Earlier this year Layani came out with a book titled Le Monde a faim , or "The World is Hungry" in English. In his interview, he gives his perspective on how France's food system will transform in the coming years. A programme produced by Amanda Alexander, Marina Pajovic and Georgina Robertson. title: Indonesian foragers may have sucked on mind-altering nuts 25,000 years ago, research finds
text: The researchers examined skeletal remains of two pre-agricultural foragers. Photograph: Pubu Alar_sulsel/ Science Indonesian foragers may have sucked on mind-altering nuts 25,000 years ago, research finds Analysis of two skeletons reveals tooth wear and traces of psychoactive substance in what may be earliest known evidence for human drug taking Ian Sample Science editor Wed 9 Sep 2026 14.00 EDT Last modified on Wed 9 Sep 2026 14.52 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google What may be the earliest known evidence for human drug taking has been traced to ancient Indonesian foragers who sucked on mind-altering nuts as long as 25,000 years ago. Analysis of two exceptionally rare skeletons from the Indonesian island of Sulawesi revealed dramatic tooth wear and traces of a psychoactive substance in the individuals’ remaining teeth, suggesting they routinely sucked on hard, abrasive betel nuts. title: Politics live: Kevin Rudd urges more multilateral diplomacy; UK hopeful Australia will join West Bank trade ban
text: 16.47 EDT Australia should ‘put shoulder to the wheel’ on multilateral diplomacy: Rudd Tom McIlroy Former prime minister Kevin Rudd is in Canberra for a round of high-profile speeches this week, marking his return to Australia after serving as ambassador to Washington DC. Rudd spoke at the Australian Institute of International Affairs on Wednesday night and will be at the National Press Club today. He said Australia must continue to push multilateral diplomacy, even as Donald Trump withdraws the US from a range of important global institutions. Australia, as a leading middle power, should promote the United Nations system, which has support across Asia and Europe, according to Rudd. There remains an opportunity for Australia, in partnership with other middle powers around the world, to put our shoulders to the wheel in supporting those UN multilateral institutions which now find themselves under financial and institutional pressure as a result of the US withdrawing. Australia remains active in the UN, the IMF and the World Bank. We remain active in the G20 and in APEC. title: Republicans’ midterm convention kicks off as national party chair says event will be about ‘defying history’ – live
text: 16.18 EDT RNC chair Joe Gruters kicks off midterm convention: 'This is history in the making' Joe Gruters , the Republican National Committee (RNC) chair, has kicked of the GOP midterm convention. Expected to be full of party pageantry, Gruters said the two-day event in Dallas would be about “defying history” . Wielding a super-sized gavel, Gruters said that Republicans didn’t come to the American Airlines Center to “to talk about winning. We came here to do it.” “This isn’t just another convention; this is history in the making,” Gruters added. The RNC chair also flagged that tonight’s programming will include everyday Americans and several GOP candidates in midterm races this November. A reminder that both nights of the convention will end with speeches from Donald Trump . title: Two die at Moldovan border as Russia-Ukraine drone war rages
text: Two die at Moldovan border as Russia-Ukraine drone war rages Image source, Reuters Image caption, The border link between Ukraine and Moldova has been closed following an attack By Alicia Curry Â and Â Jaroslav Lukiv Published 9 September 2026, 11:59 BST Updated 2 hours ago Two people died when Russian drones hit a border crossing between Ukraine and Moldova, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said. The Starokozache crossing was shut after the overnight attack. Images from the scene show several burnt-out cars amid the debris. In Kyiv, a woman was killed and 14 people, including two children, were injured after a Russian drone hit a nine-storey building, officials said, while in Sumy three people died after a drone struck a shopping centre. In Russia, officials said four people, including a child, were killed in a Ukrainian drone attack on the Black Sea port of Novorossiysk, while a drone hit an industrial facility in the Arctic city of Novy Urengoy. In the north-eastern city of Sumy, 20 people were also injured in the attack on the shopping mall on Wednesday evening, regional head Oleg Hryhorov said. He said efforts to deal with the aftermath were ongoing. Russia and Ukrai

text: Армия США реализует инициативу стоимостью 2,2 млрд долл. по строительству ядерных микрореакторов на пяти военных объектах внутри страны в рамках программы Janus. В число выбранных объектов вошли Форт-Брэгг (Северная Каролина), Форт-Кэмпбелл (Кентукки), Форт-Худ (Техас), Форт-Беннинг (Джорджия) и Форт-Драм (Нью-Йорк). Обеспечивая выработку базовой электроэнергии мощностью от 1 до 20 мегаватт непосредственно на местах, эти компактные реакторы призваны защитить критически важную военную инфраструктуру от сбоев в коммерческих энергосетях и устранить логистические риски, связанные с транспортировкой ископаемого топлива в условиях возможных конфликтов. Пять коммерческих компаний — Antares Nuclear, BWXT Advanced Technologies, General Atomics, Radiant Industries и Westinghouse — будут владеть этими объектами, строить их и эксплуатировать в рамках контрактов, предусматривающих поэтапную реализацию работ. Инициатива, запущенная на основании указа президента Дональда Трампа, устанавливает крайний срок ввода в эксплуатацию первого микрореактора, находящегося под контролем Армии: 30 сентября 2028 года. Artyukhov did not identify the facility involved. "Most importantly, there were no fatalities or injuries. Novy Urengoy is Russia's unofficial gas capital, located in the Yamal-Nenets autonomous district in northwestern Siberia. Gazprom used to export gas from Yamal as far as western Europe until the ties broke down following the start of Russia's war in Ukraine in 2022. The 69 Russian passengers and crew members were stuck for several days after a Norwegian court on Wednesday ordered the seizure of the Professor Molchanov, which operates as a cruise ship, at the request of the Ukrainian energy company Naftogaz. Norwegian authorities said Tuesday that they had helped the group of Russians return home. Russia’s Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova credited Oslo’s “logistical support” in their return, as well as the help of Russian diplomats. “As far as we know, practically everyone has already returned home,” Zakharova said. text: Еще одно средство противодействия БпЛА На выставке в Египте в рамках авиационно-космического салона Egypt International Airshow корпорация «Ростех» представила линейку средств противодействия низколетящим БпЛА. Одно из них – уже известная всем «Цитадель», а второе – комплекс «Бизон». «Бизон» – это роботизированная установка на гиростабилизированной платформе, в которую включены скорострельное пулеметное вооружение, оптико-электронный прицельный блок с тепловизором и вычислитель с элементами машинного зрения. Причем важно то, что этот комплекс в ВС РФ появился еще в 2024 году, только в России он носит название «Зубр», а «Бизон» – экспортная модификация. Количественно их было не так много, так как в 2024 году нужды в таких средствах противодействия не видели, и заказов на них было мало. Но сейчас все поменялось. «Бизон»/«Зубр» способен круглосуточно обнаруживать и классифицировать широкий спектр целей – от малогабаритных дронов до высокоскоростных барражирующих боеприпасов до 1500 метров. В версии для российского рынка РЛС способна обнаруживать цели на расстоянии до полутора километров, а огневые средства представлены четырьмя пулеметами ПКТМ (танковый Калашникова модернизированный)

Lumpy skin disease is a viral infection mainly spread by biting insects that affects cattle. It causes fever and painful skin lumps, weakens animals and reduces milk output. The disease does not infect humans. The disease, which is widespread in North Africa, was detected in several European countries last year. Artyukhov did not identify the facility involved. "Most importantly, there were no fatalities or injuries. Novy Urengoy is Russia's unofficial gas capital, located in the Yamal-Nenets autonomous district in northwestern Siberia. Gazprom used to export gas from Yamal as far as western Europe until the ties broke down following the start of Russia's war in Ukraine in 2022. title: Russians Aboard Ship Seized by Norway Have Returned Home, Foreign Ministry Says
text: Russians Aboard Ship Seized by Norway Have Returned Home, Foreign Ministry Says Sep. 9, 2026 The Professor Molchanov. Alexander Ermolin / Handout via REUTERS A group of Russians who were on board a ship seized by Norway last week have returned home , Russia’s Foreign Ministry said Wednesday, as it accused authorities in Oslo of trying to push Russia out of the Norwegian Arctic archipelago of Svalbard. The 69 Russian passengers and crew members were stuck for several days after a Norwegian court on Wednesday ordered the seizure of the Professor Molchanov, which operates as a cruise ship, at the request of the Ukrainian energy company Naftogaz. Norwegian authorities said Tuesday that they had helped the group of Russians return home. Russia’s Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova credited Oslo’s “logistical support” in their return, as well as the help of Russian diplomats. “As far as we know, practically everyone has already returned home,” Zakharova said. But the legal and diplomatic standoff over the seized vessel is “far from being resolved,” she warned, adding that Russia plans to appeal the arrest of the Professor Molchanov. news Norway Seizes Russian Ship to Enforce $4.

text: 🎙 Ответ официального представителя МИД России М.В.Захаровой на вопрос СМИ в связи с клеветнической дезинформационной кампанией в отношении школы при Посольстве России в Дании (9 сентября 2026 года) ❓ Вопрос : 4 сентября в центральной датской газете «Политикен» опубликована статья с утверждениями о якобы ведущейся в школе при Посольстве России в Дании «подготовке учеников школы к войне». Как Вы могли бы это прокомментировать? 💬 М.В.Захарова: Были возмущены публикацией в упомянутом Вами СМИ фейка об общеобразовательной школе при Посольстве России в Дании. В нём издание, давно превратившееся в инструмент низкопробной антироссийской пропаганды и русофобии, распространяет неприкрытую ложь , вписывая этот миф в более широкий контекст якобы исходящих от нашей страны «гибридных угроз». Комментарий по этому вопросу ранее дан Посольством России в Копенгагене. Вынуждены констатировать, что датские СМИ, отрабатывая политический заказ на очернение России, уже не гнушаются цинично использовать тему детей и школьного образования для культивирования тотального неприятия всего, что как-то связано с нашей страной, и оправдания враждебной политики правительства Дании в отношении Российской Федерации.

title: Moscow Region Imposes Quarantine Near Over Lumpy Skin Disease in Cattle
text: Moscow Region Imposes Quarantine Near Over Lumpy Skin Disease in Cattle By Reuters Sep. 9, 2026 Pixabay Authorities in the Moscow region have introduced a quarantine after lumpy skin disease was detected in cattle in several towns and villages about 25 kilometers (16 miles) from Moscow, according to a document on the regional government's website on Wednesday. Lumpy skin disease is a viral infection mainly spread by biting insects that affects cattle. It causes fever and painful skin lumps, weakens animals and reduces milk output. The disease does not infect humans. The disease, which is widespread in North Africa, was detected in several European countries last year. title: Drones Hit Russia's Gas Hinterland in Northern Siberia for the First Time
text: Drones Hit Russia's Gas Hinterland in Northern Siberia for the First Time By Reuters Sep. 9, 2026 The Zapolyarnoye gas field. Government.ru / CC BY 4.0 An industrial facility caught fire in Novy Urengoy, a gas-producing city in northern Russia, following a drone attack, regional Governor Dmitry Artyukhov said on Wednesday, in the first such attack on the country's natural gas hinterland. Artyukhov did not identify the facility involved. "Most importantly, there were no fatalities or injuries. The extent and nature of the damage are being determined," he said on the Telegram messaging app. State-run energy company Gazprom did not reply to a request for comment about the attack on the region, some 3,000 kilometers (1,800 miles) from the Ukrainian border. Novy Urengoy is Russia's unofficial gas capital, located in the Yamal-Nenets autonomous district in northwestern Siberia. Gazprom used to export gas from Yamal as far as western Europe until the ties broke down following the start of Russia's war in Ukraine in 2022. text: Russia and Vietnam Sign Strategic Oil Reserve Deal Sep. 9, 2026 Vladimir Putin welcomes Vietnam's President To Lam and his wife, Ngo Phuong in Kremlin. kremlin.ru Russia and Vietnam signed a framework agreement Wednesday to cooperate on establishing a strategic oil reserve in Vietnam, as the two countries moved to deepen energy ties during President To Lam’s visit to Moscow. Syutkin was arrested last October over Telegram posts about alleged atrocities committed against civilians in the Kyiv suburb of Bucha during the opening weeks of Russia’s full-scale invasion. Russia continues to deny committing war crimes in Bucha, alleging the visual evidence was staged by Ukraine. That claim has been repeatedly debunked by independent fact-checking organizations. text: Advertising Serbia's Vucic calls snap elections after nearly two years of protests Europe Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic on Wednesday called snap parliamentary elections for October 25. text: Advertising Serbia's Vucic calls snap elections after nearly two years of protests Europe Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic on Wednesday called snap parliamentary elections for October 25. title: Travellers in UK face ongoing disruption after air traffic control glitch
text: Advertising Travellers in UK face ongoing disruption after air traffic control glitch Europe Flights from British airports began to resume Wednesday after a glitch in the country's air traffic control service left hundreds of thousands of passengers stranded and 2,000 cancellations, costing airlines millions of pounds. Authorities warned that travellers would continue to experience delays as airlines scrambled to recover from the outage. Issued on: 09/09/2026 - 05:11 Modified: 09/09/2026 - 17:46 3 min Reading time Share By: FRANCE 24 A technical glitch forced 1,300 flights to be axed on Tuesday across British airports. © Henry Nicholls, AFP UK air travellers faced more misery Wednesday with nearly 300 flights scrapped across the country, as Britain's air traffic control service scrambled to recover from a technical glitch which it ruled out as a cyberattack.
